# Security policy

Report vulnerabilities in hoshi privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/nxtvoid/hoshi/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue or pull request for them.

Include the version, your OS, what an attacker can do and the steps to reproduce it. We will
answer as soon as we can and keep you posted until a fix is released. Please do not disclose the
issue publicly before then.

Security fixes go to the latest release only.
